posts.zh:
dsh-notify-skill 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-874db00601c44442f506.html
posts.en:
dsh-notify-skill is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-874db00601c44442f506.html
